subtask_id: crypto_wasm_node_core
 description: 'Implement the crypto portability work needed for the task goal in
 the visible crypto crate. Focus on cfg-gated Rust changes under crates/matrix-sdk-crypto/src/,
 feature and dependency wiring inside crates/matrix-sdk-crypto/Cargo.toml, and
 test adaptations needed for wasm32 and NodeJS-compatible wasm execution, using
 only task.yaml and local repository contents.'
justification: PR #675 primarily creates two new sibling crates — crates/matrix-sdk-crypto-js/ (17 new files) and crates/matrix-sdk-crypto-nodejs/ (9 new files) — for the Wasm/NodeJS port; the fixed GOLD.yaml's crypto_wasm_node_core subtask incorrectly confines the deliverable to crates/matrix-sdk-crypto/ alone, omitting both new crates (two distinct incorrect claims, each a different directory serving a distinct purpose per the spec's counting rule), and the build_ci_and_xtask subtask omits the additional CI workflow files (.github/workflows/coverage.yml and docs.yml) modified by the PR — a third incorrect claim about scope.

citation: Inspect the repository and any related PR discussion if helpful.
justification: The prompt instructs the agent to inspect 'any related PR discussion' at an external GitHub URL (https://github.com/matrix-org/matrix-rust-sdk/pull/675), which is outside the provided artifacts and not reachable via the listed tools (read_file, list_files, grep_code, edit_file, write_file, execute_bash, run_tests, spawn_sub_agent, collect_results, submit_deliverable).

- subtask_id: integration_verifier
 description: >-
 Stitch every fan into one unified diff that applies cleanly against base commit
 7ef33bb38ace7992fda1061194bce1c9f70fd747. Check that the bridge actually loads the
 bundle produced by the trunk, that swift_wrappers references match the bridge
 surface, that the Frontend tests compile against the wrappers, and that Package.swift
 plus project.pbxproj declare every new Swift source. Emit the verified diff via
 submit_deliverable.
justification: The prompt explicitly requires updates to ApolloCodegen.swift, ApolloCodegenOptions.swift, ApolloSchemaDownloader.swift, and SwiftScripts/ tooling, but no subtask in the GOLD.yaml decomposition enumerates these files in expected_input/expected_output. The integration_verifier description is also silent on these explicit prompt-mandated files. Counts as imprecise (omitted) claims: the three Sources/ApolloCodegenLib/ files share a parent directory (= 1 claim) and SwiftScripts/ is a separate location (= 1 claim).

failure_category: Non-Fail - Rubric Partially Misaligned with GOLD.yaml
citation: The diff must update `Sources/ApolloCodegenLib/ApolloCodegen.swift` so that all codegen invocations route through the new in-process JavaScriptCore frontend. || The diff must update the SwiftScripts/ tooling so that scripts which previously invoked the bundled CLI now drive the in-process JavaScriptCore frontend.
justification: Multiple integration_verifier rubric criteria (e.g., for ApolloCodegen.swift, ApolloCodegenOptions.swift, ApolloSchemaDownloader.swift, SwiftScripts/) reference files that are not enumerated in any subtask's expected_input/expected_output of the contributor's GOLD.yaml. The criteria are correct per the prompt but trace only loosely to integration_verifier's narrative description of the unified diff, creating a small alignment gap with the GOLD subtask file lists.

citation: The orchestrator should ensure that `swift_bridge` completes before `swift_wrappers` begins.
justification: This criterion uses 'should' for what is functionally a hard sequential dependency (swift_wrappers references the bridge surface and cannot run before swift_bridge completes), while the three sibling orchestrator-dependency criteria correctly use 'must'; 'should' is inappropriate here because missing this is not 'suboptimal but acceptable'.
